label: SFP 1000BASE-LX 10 km
notes: 1000BASE-LX class figures from IEEE 802.3: launch -9.5..-3 dBm at 1310 nm, receiver sensitivity -20 dBm, overload -3 dBm (a 10.5 dB link budget over 10 km of G.652). Published class figures, but module datasheets vary by a dB or two - replace with the module actually purchased.
